title: Rusted Cache
description: Behind a collapsed wall of rotted planks, you spot an iron lockbox half-buried in debris. Rust cakes the hinges, but the lock mechanism looks intact. This was hidden deliberately - someone's emergency fund, perhaps.

choices.label: Force it open
choices.description: Brute strength, but risk a trap.

choices.label: Work the corroded lock
choices.description: Patient effort might open it safely.

choices.label: Just take the iron box
choices.description: The box itself is worth something.

choices.label: Leave it alone
choices.description: Could be trapped. Not worth the risk.
